groups.interpretation: needs a reading of ambiguous text; skip if you disagree

excluded.item: DRF Friend / Enemy / Great Friend / Great Enemy tiers
excluded.reason: Pending decision (contract §22.2 item 4). Vectors cover identity branches, Neutral-tier derivation, the AD-secondary modifier and the clamp only.
Contract defines the four tiers but not the score thresholds that select them. Vectors take the tier as input.

excluded.item: Friend/Enemy lookup direction for asymmetric pairs
excluded.reason: The Natural Friendship Table is not symmetric (e.g. Sun lists Mercury neutral; Mercury lists Sun a friend) and the contract does not state which row is read. Vectors use symmetric pairs only.
Only Vargottama is stated to take priority; Pushkara vs dignity precedence is implied by table order only.

excluded.item: VR amplifier identity as a schema field
excluded.reason: The 16-block schema has no field recording which body triggered Z-3. Vectors pass `amplifiers` explicitly.

excluded.item: BB_norm / S_disp values strictly between published bands (e.g. 0.695, 0.845)
excluded.reason: DSSME contract does not state a half-open interval convention. Vectors use band interiors and exactly-representable lower edges.
§8 S9 Step 2 says Own or Exalted only.
Not exercised; vectors use the seven classical planets.

excluded.item: Step K digit magnitudes (K.6 emphasis tiers); S15 authorization; Z-gates; S1
excluded.reason: Unchanged by v1.6 and out of scope for these vectors.
Pending decision (§22.2 item 5). S12 vectors use uniform T so they hold under either choice.
